crop.notes: Clipping is the continuation of the 'Pugilism' sports column (Dunleavy/Cornwell, Creedon, Erne, Ruhlin/Sharkey items). Allen appears only in one sentence of the Dan Creedon paragraph, which is fully inside the clipping; the column's start and end are outside it.

ocr.notes: Gist readable, many errors; the Allen sentence is readable ('Tom Al-len'). End of transcript is garbled.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat, writing about Dan Creedon's latest defeat, said Dannie Daly, Tom Kelly and Tom Allen had been real St. Louis champions but belonged to an earlier, "mastodonic" period of boxing.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, April 20, 1902, page 14.

notes: Single passing mention; no biographical facts beyond Allen being remembered as a former St. Louis champion.
